## Install

You need a [Sarvam AI](https://dashboard.sarvam.ai) API key (new accounts get free credits). After installing, open the extension's **Settings** and paste it in.

| Browser | Download | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| **Chrome / Edge / Brave** | `bak-bak-{{version}}-chrome.zip` | Unzip → `chrome://extensions` → turn on **Developer mode** → **Load unpacked** → pick the unzipped folder. |
| **Firefox** (140+) | `bak-bak-{{version}}-firefox.zip` | `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox` → **Load Temporary Add-on…** → pick the zip. Stays until Firefox restarts (unsigned build). |
| **Safari** (26+) | `bak-bak-{{version}}-safari.zip` | Unzip → Safari Settings → Advanced → **Show features for web developers** → Developer → **Add Temporary Extension…** → pick the folder. Stays until Safari quits. |

`bak-bak-{{version}}-sources.zip` is the source bundle for Firefox Add-ons review.

These are developer builds; store listings will follow.
